name.baseName: Natural gas, high pressure, at consumer

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Infrastructure requirements are based on estimated standard capacity. The net calorific value of natural gas is 36.0 MJ/Nm³. UUID=047f0851-aa9e-364f-8628-6e497292e6db

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Energy requirements are from 2019 and leakage data are from 2018. Trade movements investigated for 2023.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Energy requirements and emissions are based on Swiss data. Calculations include production and transport of natural gas from 34 countries.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
The quantity of gas delivered in the high pressure network is estimated. Industry, power plants and half of commercial and of other sectors are assumed to consume high pressure gas.

# Included processes
This dataset describes the structure of the 0 gas mix with regard to the countries of origin and the energy requirements and the emissions of the high pressure distribution network.
